sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily. I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Sri Lanka.
Sri Lanka is a tropical, green and beautiful island country in South Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready? Let's begin.
Where is Sri Lanka?
Sri Lanka is an island country in the Indian Ocean.
It is just south of India.
It has beaches, forests, hills and tea plantations.
What is the capital city of Sri Lanka?
Sri Lanka has two capitals,
Colombo, the main city and commercial center.
Sri Jaya warden Apura Kota,
the official capital and home of Parliament.
Colombo is full of markets, offices, traffic and coastal views.
Other cities include candy in the hills with a famous temple,
galley with a colonial fort by the sea,
Jafna in the north with Tamil culture.
How many people live in Sri Lanka?
About 22 million people live in Sri Lanka.
People live in cities, villages and farming areas.
Many work in agriculture, tourism or trade.
What language do people speak in Sri Lanka?
There are two main official languages,
Sinhala, Tamil.
Many people also speak English,
especially in schools and cities.
Some signs and documents are in all three languages.
What is the weather like in Sri Lanka?
Sri Lanka has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid most of the year.
There are two monsoon seasons with heavy rain.
Some areas are cooler, especially in the central hills.
The country is green with lots of rain and sunshine.
What does Sri Lanka look like?
Sri Lanka has long beaches,
green hills and tea fields,
rainforests and waterfalls,
temples, cities and old ruins.
It is sometimes called the Pearl of the Indian Ocean.
What animals live in Sri Lanka?
Sri Lanka is home to many animals.
Elephants, leopards and monkeys,
crocodiles, lizards and snakes,
peacocks, parrots and eagles,
whales, turtles and fish in the sea.
There are many national parks to protect wildlife.
What do people eat in Sri Lanka?
Sri Lankan food is spicy, colorful and full of flavor.
People eat rice, the main food,
lentils, vegetables and curry,
coconut used in many dishes,
fish, chicken or beef,
popular dishes, rice and curry served with small side dishes,
dal, lentil stew,
hoppers, full-shaped pancakes made from rice flour,
kodu chopped roti bread fried with meat and vegetables,
pulse-amble spicy coconut salad.
What do people drink in Sri Lanka?
People drink tea.
Sri Lanka is famous for Ceylon tea,
water and fresh fruit juice,
king coconut water,
sweet and natural.
Adults may drink a rack,
a strong local alcohol.
Tea is served hot with or without milk and sugar.
What is life like in Sri Lanka?
Life in Sri Lanka is family-centered,
spiritual and peaceful.
People enjoy spending time with family,
going to the temple or church,
cooking and sharing food,
walking on the beach or in the hills,
watching cricket, the most popular sport.
What are some holidays and traditions?
Sinhala and Tamil New Year,
in April with food and games.
Vaisak in May celebrates the life of Buddha,
Deepa Vavali, Hindu festival of life,
Christmas celebrated by Christians,
Independence Day, February 4th.
People celebrate with lights,
flowers, music and family meals.
Some fun facts about Sri Lanka.
Sri Lanka was called Ceylon in the past.
It is one of the world's top producers of tea.
The national flag is known as the lion flag.
Buddhism is the main religion,
but Hinduism, Islam and Christianity are also present.
Sri Lanka has UNESCO World Heritage sites,
like Siguria and Anuradapura.
Now you know many things about Sri Lanka.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the tea, the temples and the culture.
Well done.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Sinhala,
Are you bow on?
